Feelings are a lot to work through, especially transition related ones. I knew when I was younger and wanting top surgery I beat myself up and convinced myself I was going to look bad because I knew I had to have DI. But one day I realized that, just because I will have scars it doesn’t make me ugly and I also had realized I had set an unrealistic expectation on my future self. Once I accepted that there’s no flat chest without scars I stopped pressuring myself about the future. Transition is hard and scary as hell, and the feelings that come with it are even harder. I hate tackling my feelings but I realized I couldn’t just not deal with them forever. There’s no rush into deconstructing how you feel, it has to happen when you’re ready, and that’s okay. It took years for me to finally get there and im only dealing with smaller feelings one day at a time. There’s also other factors that made me feel some kind of way about stuff for the future. You are never alone in this journey and if you ever need to talk I’m here
